{{External|rs=Gem stall|rsc=Gems Stall (scenery)}} {{Otheruses|thievable Gem stalls across Gielinor|the thievable shop counter in [[Mor Ul Rek]]|Shop Counter (gems)|other stalls|Gem stall (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Scenery |version1 = Ardougne and Kourend |version2 = Keldagrim |version3 = Prifddinas |version4 = Civitas illa Fortis |name1 = Gem stall |name2 = Gem Stall |name3 = Gem stall |name4 = Gem stall |image1 = [[File:Gem stall.png|250x250px]] |image2 = [[File:Gem Stall (Keldagrim).png|250x250px]] |image3 = [[File:Gem stall (Prifddinas).png|250x250px]] |image4 = [[File:Gem stall (Civitas illa Fortis).png|250x250px]] |release1 = [[30 April]] [[2002]] |release2 = [[21 March]] [[2005]] |release3 = [[25 July]] [[2019]] |release4 = [[20 March]] [[2024]] |update1 = Latest RuneScape News (30 April 2002) |update2 = Between a Rock... |update3 = Song of the Elves |update4 = Varlamore: Part One |members = Yes |quest = No |location1 = [[Ardougne]], [[Great Kourend]] |location2 = [[Keldagrim]] |location3 = [[Prifddinas]] |location4 = [[Civitas illa Fortis]] |options = Steal-from |examine1 = Precious stones from around the world. |examine2 = Finest precious stones. |examine3 = Finest precious stones. |examine4 = Precious stones from around the world. |map = No |id1 = 11731 |id2 = 6162 |id3 = 36571 |id4 = 51935 }} A '''gem stall''' is a [[stall]], which may be stolen from at level 75 [[Thieving]], granting 408 Thieving [[experience]]. There is a respawn time of 60 seconds. Thieving from the [[Green Gemstone Gems]] stall is a requirement for the [[Fremennik Diary|Fremennik Hard Diary]]. A [[Gem stall (Al Kharid)|gem stall]] can be found next to the [[Gem trader]] in [[Al Kharid]], but players cannot steal from it. ==Locations== {{ObjectTableHead}} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Gem stall |location = [[East Ardougne]] |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2668,y:3303 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Gem stall |location = [[Keldagrim]] (partial completion of {{SCP|Quest}} [[The Giant Dwarf]]) |members = Yes |mapID = 10 |plane = 0 |x:2887,y:10210 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Gem stall |location = [[Great Kourend]] |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:1634,y:3684|mtype = pin |x:1640,y:3662 |leagueRegion = Kourend }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Gem stall |location = [[Prifddinas]] (completion of {{SCP|Quest}} [[Song of the Elves]]) |members = Yes |mapID = 29 |plane = 0 |x:3277,y:6101 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Tirannwn }} {{ObjectLocLine |name = Gem stall |location = [[Civitas illa Fortis]] (completion of {{SCP|Quest}} [[Children of the Sun]]) |members = Yes |mapID = -1 |plane = 0 |x:1674,y:3101 |x:1676,y:3098 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Varlamore }} {{ObjectTableBottom}} ==Thieving info== {{Thieving info |name = Gem stall |level = 75 |xp = 408 |type = Stall |time = 60 seconds }} Stealing from a gem stall is worth {{Coins|{{Average drop value|mob=Gem stall|raw=y}}}} on average. ===Regular=== {{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1260210901434630145|date=12 May 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101774|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=Out of 128: 105 -
